meta.intro: 网络知名表情包“小废柴”去世，但它留下的印记不会褪去。

content.v: “Balltze fell asleep on August 18… during his last
surgery
,” Kathy wrote in a post on Instagram. The post quickly spread on the internet. Many people felt very sad about the news. Who was Balltze? Why was he so popular online?
Balltze was a 12-year-old
Shiba Inu
. He loved eating
cheeseburgers
. This earned him the nickname “Cheems”. He lived in Hong Kong. A girl named Kathy
adopted
him when he was one year old. She opened an Instagram
account
in 2015. Since then, she started sharing pictures of Balltze with other dog lovers.
Two years later, Balltze became famous overnight after Kathy posted a new picture. In the picture, the dog is sitting quietly, with a
puzzled
look on his face. Balltze won the hearts of the world because all of us may feel helpless at some time in our lives. So far, the Instagram account has had more than 768,000 followers.

In the post, Kathy told the followers not to be sad. “Remember the joy Balltze brought to the world,” she wrote. Many people will never forget this lovely dog. He brought happiness to so many people’s lives. You’ll always live in our hearts, Balltze. We will miss you very much. Thank you for sharing your life with us all these years.
